lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The next day,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm is acting strangely.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Helm?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: S-Subordinate...!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: How long have you been there?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I've been calling you for a while.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh... Sorry. My mind was elsewhere.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Did you have a task for me?
It's not that.
I was going to ask you to support Liter.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I have some urgent matters to attend to, so if you'll excuse me.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm runs off before I can say anything else.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: She's repairing the detection machine, right?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll go help her right now.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Just a minu...

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Helm rushes off without bothering to listen to the details.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Hey, Greenhorn.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm looking for Helm.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Ah,

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: She was helping me with the repair until a little while ago.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Once she knew you were coming, she scurried off into the woods.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: What's the deal? Did you two have a fight or something?
No.
I have no idea.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Well, at any rate, she was heading towards the coastal hotel.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: She didn't say much, but it was clear that she was going through something.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Go talk to her, or apologize if you've done something wrong.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: We're still gonna be on this island for a good long while,

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: so it'd be in your best interest to patch things up with her.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... Helm.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Subordinate!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Why are you avoiding me?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's not like that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just needed some space.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So please, just...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Would you leave me alone? I'm begging you.
Do you have a problem with the advice I've been giving you?
Are you trying to take on every task yourself again?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What? No.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What you said yesterday really impacted me.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I know that I have to change.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I saw that there was potential in me to make things better.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Please don't ever think the problem rests with you in any way.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What? No.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Yesterday,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: you told me to place more trust in others and rely on them more.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I was up all night pondering

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: how I could put that into practice.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If my problem was something that could be solved by asking for help, I would have that already.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This all has to do with my condition,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: so I knew there was no point in consulting you on it.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Your condition?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Did I say something wrong?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Helm, I'm your superior.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's my job to make sure you're taken care of.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: If you're going through something, why would it be pointless to talk to me about it?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's just that...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I didn't mean to

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: undermine your authority in any way.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm just a bit overwhelmed at the moment, and I wasn't thinking straight.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: My authority is not the problem.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: The problem is that you're in bad shape, and that I have no idea what's wrong or how to help.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Honestly, it's not what you think.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This is something I have to solve on my own. Time will tell if I'm up to the task.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: At least give me something to go on. What exactly is wrong?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's my heart.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It keeps racing.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: My face also gets hot, like it's been burned.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: My work efficiency has gone down the drain because of all the anxiety I'm feeling.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I have no idea why I'm like this, though.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: We should get you checked out.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'd have to take off my clothes for that!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: If you're not feeling well, that should be the least of your worries.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: No, what I mean is...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll take them off,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but can you turn the other way?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Then you can tell me where to start.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's okay. It'll only take a few minutes.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I give Helm an examination as quickly as possible.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Your heart is beating a million miles per hour.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You're running a bit of a temperature as well. Could be a low fever.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Like I said.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's been like this for a few days now.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If anything, it's gotten worse.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Actually, it's been like this ever since I first met you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: As if something sharp is poking and prodding at my heart.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: To be honest,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I don't know much about this,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: or how to solve it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: And I don't want to know.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You're my superior, and a human.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've been trying to keep you at a distance, but...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: talk to me. Please.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You know about these things.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You're the commander who's poised to become the stuff of legend.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You're observant of your surroundings.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You taught me how to get along with my co-workers.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So tell me, how do I take these feelings and bury them?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: How can I undo this situation when it's become such a tangled mess?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Can't you tell me what to do?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can help you in this situation.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: What you do from here is entirely up to you.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's only something you'd say if you felt the same way about me...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I kiss Helm.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Mmm!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Wha... What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Say it, or don't.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's up to you now.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Why would you...?!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I told you, I don't know much about this.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You have to hold my hand through it, starting with the basics.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm a fast learner, so...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: So that's your answer. I get it.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I give Helm another kiss.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Startled, her knees buckle and she kneels on the grass.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Then I'll teach you.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I've taught you many other things before. Now I'll teach you about love.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Okay. Got it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll do whatever you tell me to do.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's what I've always done during our time together,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and you've never once

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ignored or minimized my feelings.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The midsummer drizzle gently falls down on us until we're drenched.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: We only dry off once the sun re-emerges a few hours later.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: We remain in the same spot, transfixed the entire time.
